Name: Protagonist
Desc: Being the youngest champion of U15 Pokemon Championship, you have been widely respected as the best prodigy of the generation. People are thrilled at your strategic capabilities and tactics that often clutch victories at the most challenging moments. You have earned your spot into the Official Pokemon Championship held per annum, where the best talents all around the universe compete against each other.

Name: Goblin
Desc: Goblin is simply a goblin. Dim, old, and weak.
Quote: I may be old. I may be weak. But I am certainly not blind.
Strategy:
Ace: Grimmsnarl
Ability: Dim
Dim: decrease speed, but increase accuracy.

Name: Beatrice
Desc: Born into a renowned line of elite, Dragon-type user family, Beatrice spent her childhood overwhelmed by impossible expectations, bursting into tears every time a training turned intense. She eventually left the family silently as she thought it was too difficult. Over years of dragon training, she only managed to tame a Turtonator. Recently, she finally resurfaced only because she realized it was not too difficult to get over the preliminaries stage.
Quote: Could you please go easy on me? I have had a hard time... sob…
Strategy:
Ace: Turtonator
Ability: Tension Release
Tension Release: at the end of every turn both sides' pokemon are forced to switch out, and her moves always act at -1 priority.

Name: Trasher
Desc: Trasher grew up in places full of trash. He seeks to prove himself in the Pokemon World Championship to change his fate. He is well known for his Garbador, his first and strongest pokemon.
Quote: I will prove to you that there is really treasure in a pile of trash!
Strategy:
Ace: Garbodor
Ability: Trashy
Trashy: poison-type moves' power increases by 30%.

Name: Jason
Desc: Jason is a fresh graduate specialized in pokemon studies who thinks he is the real deal. He will actively avoid routine work by procrastinating until the last second, as he thinks these work do not prove his real ability. He fails his probation due to his bad working quality and remains jobless ever since.
Quote: Why do I need to do this by myself? There are better candidates.
Strategy:
Ace: Durant
Ability: Procrastination
Procrastination: inverse the priority of the moves.

Name: Solanum
Desc: Solanum has finally built a spaceship to escape from the Quantum Moon, so that he can participate into the Pokemon World Championship just in time.
Quote: We do not have much connection, you and I. Still, this encounter feels special. I hope you won't mind if I think of you as a friend.
Strategy:
Ace: Alakazam
Ability: Quantum Roll
Quantum Roll: 3 of the 18 types cannot reach her pokemon for a turn, and the next turn's three are announced a turn ahead. Attacking moves only - status moves always land. From turn 2 onwards.

Name: President Rose
Desc: President Rose is a moronic person in Pokemon Sword & Shield who seeks to obtain infinite energy from a legendary pokemon but backfired hard.
Quote: 1000 years later, I predict that there will be an energy crisis wiping the humanity.
Strategy:
Ace: Copperajah
Ability: Energy Imbalance
Energy Imbalance: trigger Sudden Death at the last pokemon.

Name: Dulunga
Desc: Dulunga was once an experienced desert soldier, and the desert has not finished with him. Sand follows him onto any field where something walks on the ground -- his or yours. He would still rather be playing the Pokemon TCG.
Quote: It takes skills to utilize the terrain for your advantage.
Strategy:
Ace: Sandaconda
Ability: Desert Wind
Desert Wind: a Ground type on the field, either side, brings up a sandstorm.

Name: Alton
Desc: Alton is a 26-year-old mechanical engineer who trains Pokémon in his free time between workshop projects and blueprint revisions. He is a solid opponent who relies more on careful planning and creative strategies than raw power. Practical and methodical, Alton approaches every battle like an engineering problem that just needs the right solution.
Poke1: Psyduck | iv=50 | ability=Cloud Nine | moves=Hypnosis, Blizzard, Hydro Pump, Zen Headbutt
Quote: My blueprint is done… time for execution.
Strategy:
Ace: Psyduck
Ability: Calibration
Calibration: moves will never miss the target.

Name: Pudding
Desc: Pudding is a small boy who likes snacks.
Quote: I love ice-cream!!!
Strategy:
Ace: Vanilluxe
Ability: Naive
Naive: trap opposing and own pokemon.

Name: Ophelia
Desc: Ophelia is a soft-spoken sanctuary keeper from the frozen northern peaks. Beneath her gentle, clerical demeanor lies an unshakeable resolve, she warms up the poor and those who suffer from freezing and hypothermia with her power of blessing and her Chandelure. Her lantern serves as a beacon in the darkest blizzards, leading weary travelers and lost children home. Her championship run is rather a testament of knowledge and patience, with her quietly beautiful, defensive battle style that smothers her opponents' momentum.
Quote: Those who get lost shall return, and those who suffer in winter cold deserve a good rest around cozy fire. Allow me to show you the light within the shadow.
Strategy:
Ace: Chandelure
Ability: Lamplighter
Lamplighter: at the end of each turn, whichever Pokemon whose HP is lower loses another sixteenth of its HP.

Name: Abota
Desc: Abota was a Mongolian horse archer a long time ago. After his glorious retirement, he is addicted to Pokemon Battle.
Quote: One stone can hit two birds; Give me one more shot, and I will wipe out your whole team with it.
Strategy:
Ace: Galarian Rapidash
Ability: Violence
Violence: moves with direct contact increase power by 30%.

Name: Coco
Desc: Coco is a free-spirited 20-year-old girl who enjoys surfing and travelling. She travels the islands and the world with her trusted partners, challenging Gyms and fellow Trainers while chasing the thrill of every battle. Known for her bright energy and unshakable optimism, Coco gets electricized whenever she is in a battle.
Quote: Let the battle be electrifying!
Strategy:
Ace: Alolan Raichu
Ability: Sparking Cascade
Sparking Cascade: starts off the battle with an electric terrain, and every turn there is a 10% chance that target non-flying type pokemon will be paralyzed (except ground and electric type)

Name: Big Bryan
Desc: Big Bryan is an enormous guy. At school, he is famous for eating 5 bowls of rice during lunch time. If he stands on the chair and jumps, it is likely the chair will break.
Quote: Is that food?
Strategy:
Ace: Snorlax
Ability: Gluttony
Gluttony: consume unfavorable entry hazard and target's barrier (e.g. Tailwind, Light Screen etc.).

Name: Mindfield
Desc: Mindfield is a Professor specializing in Neuroscience. His main contribution includes successfully encouraging his University to open up the first-ever Pokemon major in the world.
Quote: Neuroscience is by far the most exciting branch of science because the brain is the most fascinating object in the universe. Every human brain is different - the brain makes each human unique and defines who he or she is.
Strategy:
Ace: Bruxish
Ability: Brain Wave
Brain Wave: starts the battle with Psychic Terrain, and increase damage by 50% and additional effect chance by 30% for psychic-type moves.

Name: Clown Marcus
Desc: Marcus is a mentally-challenged trainer who somehow goes into the Playoffs stage since his opponents in the Preliminary stage are either sick or have forfeited their match. Truly the luckiest person ever.
Quote: I am an Idiot. I am a Clown. Please laugh at me!
Strategy:
Ace: Gyarados
Ability: Moody
Moody: increase opponent Pokemon HP by 10% (10%), decrease opponent Pokemon HP by 10% (20%).

Name: Aphelios
Desc: Aphelios has lived in the world for 200 years. He is sick of staying in the world of League and instead seeks to find joy in Pokemon Battle. Due to his experience and time, he has developed several prominent Pokemon.
Quote: I may have lived for 200 years, but there is still so much to learn and master.
Strategy:
Ace: Blacephalon
Ability: Fireworks
Fireworks: deduct-HP moves deduct 50% less HP (e.g. Mind Blown, Belly Drum, Explosion) and boost power for Mind Blown by 20%.

Name: King Bosse
Desc: King Bosse is known for one of the strongest man on Earth. He hit extremely hard, but he is also very slow.
Quote: Miranjo, just wait for a little more. I am coming.
Strategy:
Ace: Mamoswine
Ability: Heavy Blow
Heavy Blow: increase attack by 2 stages but decrease speed by 2 stages.

Name: Bojji
Desc: Bojji is a cursed giant with no physical strength. In compensation, he is extremely nimble, allowing him to dodge attack, and he is good at hitting the vital point of the opponent to win over them.
Strategy:
Ace: Scorchrome (Custom)
Ability: Nimble
Nimble: decrease attack by 2 stages, but increase speed by 2 stages.

Name: Takagi
Desc: Takagi is a crafty girl who has many small tricks and pranks. She still seeks Pokemon Battle as stress relief.
Quote: You finally look at me. Hehehe
Strategy:
Ace: Charmorin (Custom)
Ability: Charm
Charm: distracting opponent and opposing pokemon, causing it to miss its move.

Name: Shuka
Desc: Karino Shuka is a main character of Darwin's Game as well as a member of Sunset Ravens. Shuka is typically friendly with people but can become deadly if needed.
Quote: If I didn't want to die, I shouldn't have been born, right?
Strategy:
Ace: Nidoqueen
Ability: String Manipulation
String Manipulation: decrease target Pokemon speed by 1 stage (20%).

Name: Rum
Desc: Rum is the second-in-hand of the Black Organization. He is known to be ruthless and crafty, but he is also impatient.
Quote: I am the Second-in-hand of the Black Organization, and my hobby is making sushi and stalking an old man.
Strategy:
Ace: Crobat
Ability: Impatient
Impatient: trigger Sudden Death (1%), decrease own Pokemon HP by 12.5% and target Pokemon HP by 25% (20%).

Name: Misty
Desc: Misty is the Gym Leader of Cerulean City's Gym. She is once specialized in Water-type Pokemon. She got bored of her Gym Leader life and decided to take a break to look for Ash Ketchum, thereby participating in the World Pokemon Championship.
Quote: Sometimes I look at that Psyduck's face and I get a headache.
Strategy:
Ace: Starmie
Ability: Soak
Soak: add Water type to pokemon.

Name: Mount
Desc: Mount is a prominent talent currently playing the position of CAM for the Chelsea Football Club.
Quote: You don't need eleven people when one is enough.
Strategy:
Ace: Cinderace
Ability: Ball Trick
Ball Trick: increase power by 50% for ball/bomb moves.

Name: Diantha
Desc: Diantha is the Champion of the Kalos region. However, she is well known to be the weakest champion in the Pokemon main series franchise.
Quote: Witnessing the noble spirits of you and your Pokemon in battle has really touched my heart...
Strategy:
Ace: Gardevoir
Ability: Champion
Champion: increase Atk and SpA by 1 stage for Ace.

Name: Devoltorm
Desc: Devoltorm is a sorcerer who traded his name away for power and now insists everyone use the one he chose himself. He keeps an angelic face and a courtier's manners, and speaks of cruelty as though it were simply good sense.
Quote: There is no good and evil, there is only power and those too weak to seek it.
Strategy:
Ace: Nightdaunter (Custom)
Ability: Tenebrous
Tenebrous: increase damage by 30% and additional effect chance by 30% for dark-type and ghost-type moves.

Name: Mordekaiser
Desc: Mordekaiser is tired of battling with the other champions in League of Legends. He wants a change of his life.
Quote: I will silence the incessant thrum of mortal hearts.
Strategy:
Ace: Boneknight (Custom)
Ability: Death Realm
Death Realm: randomly increase stats by one stage when causing Pokemon to faint.

Name: Therion
Desc: Therion is a master thief known throughout the realm thanks to his multiple exploits in stealing. It is mentioned that almost no one knows of Therion's face despite his infamy,  and that he is the enemy of every wealthy home and person.
Quote: Like a thief in the night.
Strategy:
Ace: Gengar
Ability: Thief
Thief: steal target pokemon positive stat stages (20%).

Name: Makise Kurisu
Desc: Kurisu Makise is the daughter of Shouichi Makise, a genius girl who graduated from university at the age of seventeen, and a member of the Brain Science Institute at Viktor Chondria University and the Future Gadget Lab.
Quote: I don't want to deny who I've been. Because even my failures are a part of who I am today.
Strategy:
Ace: Tsareena
Ability: Time Travel
Time Travel: immune to increased-priority moves.

Name: Berserker
Desc: Berserker is a ruthless crazy barbarian who is more resilient when in danger. He is not good at capturing a lead but he is very good at comebacks.
Quote: BUWARKKKKKKKKKKKKK!!!!!
Strategy:
Ace: Vindaxe (Custom)
Ability: Barbaric
Barbaric: drain 30% damage as HP at 50% HP or below.

Name: Fae
Desc: A playful pure pixie fairy who dances through the moonlit glades. Despite her tiny size and cheerful demeanor, Fae commands potent fairy magic, weaving light barriers to keep unwelcome intruders at bay.
Quote: Shed no tear! oh, shed no tear! The flower will bloom another year!
Strategy:
Ace: Maruka
Ability: Pixelate
Pixelate: starts with misty terrain, and all normal-type moves become fairy-type moves. Her normal and fairy moves hit 1.2x harder.

Name: Yagami Light
Desc: Light is characterized as hardworking, talented, and a natural genius. Highly perceptive and good with problem solving skills, Light is a skilled planner and good at mapping out scenarios. Furthermore, Light is very popular among peers and adored by his family members. He often carries a notebook on his hand for no reason.
Quote: May I ask what is your name? ^_^
Strategy:
Ace: Xurkitree
Ability: Death Note
Death Note: opposing pokemon with >1 stat stages will automatically suffer from Perish Count.

Name: Kurtosis
Desc: Kurtosis is an outlier. A black horse.
Quote: Kurtosis is a measure of the combined weight of a distribution's tails relative to the center of the distribution.
Strategy:
Ace: Spectrier
Ability: Outliers
Outliers: his attacks deal anywhere from 0.8x to 1.4x their damage, at random. The average is ordinary; the tails are not.

Name: Sterling
Desc: A rising star in the competitive tennis world, Sterling has claimed multiple regional championships and remains undefeated in her last twenty matches. Known for her razor-sharp reflexes and relentless drive, she continues to push the limits of her game with every training session.
Quote: I donâ€™t just play to winâ€¦ I play to dominate the court.
Strategy:
Ace: Clawitzer
Ability: Cross Court
Cross Court: attacks choose the lower of Defense or Special Defense.

Name: Paul
Desc: Paul is initially not a caring Trainer as he wants pure power from his Pokemon and the Trainers he faces to be strong. Paul is also known to release his Pokemon if he deems them weak or useless, which seems somewhat appropriate because of his ambition and seeing his Pokemon as tools for his own glory.
Quote: Pathetic.
Strategy:
Ace: Electivire
Ability: Calm
Calm: immune to any non-volatile status.

Name: Samantha
Desc: Raised in a wealthy, indulgent family where her every whim was met without question, Samantha grew up completely unused to being told "no." Her fiery temper and stubborn streak stem from a lifetime of getting her way, making any compromise feel like an insult. In both battles and relationships, she expects total devotion; and the moment she feels challenged, she would rather tear everything down than back down first.
Quote: I am gonna head out. Leave me alone!
Strategy:
Ace: Arcanine
Ability: Anger Point
Anger Point: when own Pokémon takes a critical hit or status condition, its Attack/Special Attack stat sharply rises.

Name: Steven
Desc: Steven is the Champion of the Hoenn region. He is specialised in using Steel type Pokemon. However, this does not mean that he will be exclusively using Rock and Steel type Pokemon in the Championship.
Quote: Rock is Sturdy. Steel is Versatile. I wish your heart as hard as the mix of Rock and Steel. You still have a long journey, go for it!
Strategy:
Ace: Metagross
Ability: Champion
Champion: increase Atk and SpA by 1 stage for Ace.

Name: Auraia
Desc: Auraia shines both on and off the screen, captivating audiences with her genuine warmth and effortless elegance. Often seen draped in soft whites and luminous pastels that highlight her natural beauty, she exudes an approachable grace that makes her feel like a close friend. Her star power isn't just about glamour; it's rooted in her down-to-earth spirit and magnetic kindness.
Quote: True beauty isn't found in a spotlight, but in the light you share with others.
Strategy:
Ace: Jirachi
Ability: Serene Grace
Serene Grace: any secondary effect her moves carry lands 80% of the time, however unlikely it normally is.

Name: Libelle
Desc: A cheerful bug enthusiast who finds joy in every tiny creature. She spends her days exploring meadows and forests, quietly observing the small lives that most people overlook.
Quote: The smallest wings can carry the biggest wonders.
Strategy:
Ace: Yanmega
Ability: Field Study
Field Study: her attacks grow stronger for each different pokemon she has seen on the field, up to 40%. Two of the same species teach her once.

Name: Lance
Desc: Lance is a Dragon-type Trainer, a member of the Indigo Elite Four, and later the Champion of the Indigo Plateau. He is known for using 3 Dragonite in the Champion battle.
Quote: So you think you can defeat a dragon trainer? En garde.
Strategy:
Ace: Dragonite
Ability: Champion
Champion: increase Atk and SpA by 1 stage for Ace.

Name: Velvet
Desc: Seductive, icy-cool, and dangerously calculated. Velvet uses high-society galas and executive infiltration as her disguise, leveraging charm and brief, lethal distractions to steal top-secret data before vanishing into the dark.
Quote: Keep your eyes on me, darling... I want to infiltrate into your heart... and your secrets.
Strategy:
Ace: Inteleon
Ability: Infiltration
Infiltration: Moves will ignore target pokemon ability and weather effects, and entry hazards do not affect her pokemon.

Name: Rudolf
Desc: Rudolf is a ruler of a certain country. He has made the country better with controversial policies. To these days, some appreciate his thoughtfulness and execution, while some do not like how he bended the rules at times.
Quote: Those who bear defeat are the truly mighty ones.
Strategy:
Ace: Ygadr (Custom)
Ability: Memento
Memento: when one of his pokemon faints, the opposing pokemon loses 2 stages of Attack and 2 stages of Special Attack.

Name: Gin
Desc: Gin is a merciless and efficient assassin. He has no compunctions about killing or threatening fellow teammates. Fitting his icy personality, Gin's displayed range of emotions so far is relatively limited. He is the main antagonist of Detective Conan and is the most loyal to the Black Organization.
Quote: If life is a color, it is going to be Silver.
Strategy:
Ace: Naganadel
Ability: Ruthless
Ruthless: deal damage depending on the difference between target HP and user HP, the higher the difference (target HP > user HP), the more damage (up to 1.7x). On the other hand, suffer 30% more damage from target pokemon.

Name: The Trio
Desc: The trio of pill-shaped yellow cartoon assistants views every match as a high-tech playground. They rely on modified high-tech gear and custom launcher devices to trigger field effects and baffle opponents. Unpredictable and wildly energetic, their chaotic tinkering makes them an instant crowd favorite.
Quote: Bello! BANANA!
Strategy:
Ace: Rotom (Frost)
Ability: Overloaded
Overloaded: the move that has been played has a 20% chance to strike a second time, like a two-hit move.

Name: Jack the Ripper
Desc: Jack the Ripper was an unidentified serial killer active in the impoverished districts in and around Whitechapel in the East End of London in 1888. In both criminal case files and the contemporary journalistic accounts, the killer was called the Whitechapel Murderer and Leather Apron.
Quote: Ninety years ago I was a freak. Today I'm an amateur. Ninety years later I will be a Pokemon professional.
Strategy:
Ace: Darkrai
Ability: Irrational
Irrational: increase Atk, SpA, Spd by 1 stage, but confused for 2-5 turns.

Name: Albert Einstein
Desc: Albert Einstein was a German-born theoretical physicist, widely acknowledged to be one of the greatest and most influential physicists of all time. Einstein is best known for developing the theory of relativity, but he also made important contributions to the development of the theory of quantum mechanics.
Quote: I have no special talent. I am only passionately curious.
Strategy:
Ace: Porygon-Z
Ability: Light Speed
Light Speed: starts the battle on Electric Terrain, and pokemon are immune to Ground-type damage.

Name: Petra
Desc: Petra is a brilliant field surveyor and structural engineer in Krusades known for her sharp spatial awareness and relentless work ethic. Some of the best construction projects are initiated by her.
Quote: It is easy to destroy, but hard to build.
Strategy:
Ace: Rhyperior
Ability: Groundwork
Groundwork: the battle begins with Stealth Rock already scattered on the opponent's side of the field.

Name: Serena
Desc: Serena is a world-renowned Showcase performer who treats every Pokémon match like a grand stage routine. Blending elegant choreography with dazzling battle tactics, she captivates the audience while seamlessly dictating the rhythm of the arena. She steps into the Pokemon Championship because of her childhood crush, Ash Ketchum.
Quote: Never give up until the very end!
Strategy:
Ace: Delphox
Ability: Synchronize
Synchronize: negative stat changes to own pokemon are also inflicted on the target pokemon, and positive stat changes on the target pokemon are also gained by own pokemon.

Name: Elowen
Desc: A soft-spoken young elven girl, Elowen possesses a deep, intuitive bond with the ancient woods far exceeding her years. Gentle and unassuming, her eyes, reminiscent of the wise mage Frieren, hold a timeless understanding of the wild. She is a tender guardian who uses her innate elven magic to nurture nature's growth.
Quote: Please rest a while... let the forest heal your poor soul.
Strategy:
Ace: Tangrowth
Ability: Sylvan Sprout
Sylvan Sprout: plants a Sylvan seed on every opponent pokemon that switches in. A Sylvan seed drains 1/16 of their HP a turn and heals the same to her own - half of what Leech Seed does. Grass types are immune to it, and it does not stack.

Name: Lusamine
Desc: Lusamine is the main antagonist of Pokemon Sun and Moon. She is the president of Aether Paradise but she is obsessed with Ultra Beasts. She can get really dangerous when she slowly descends into a psychopath.
Quote: My sweet Pokemon... I promise I'll keep you safe... I'll protect you with my love.
Strategy:
Ace: Bewear/Nihilego
Ability: Ultra Boost
Ultra Boost: increase one random stat stage at the start.

Name: Violet Evergarden
Desc: Violet is a former soldier who was enlisted in the Leidenschaftlich army and fought in the war, where she was treated as nothing more than a weapon. Violet became an Auto Memories Doll at the CH Postal Company after the war, seeking to understand the meaning of the words "I love you," which was said to her by her major Gilbert Bougainvillea, during the War's final battle.
Quote: It is a pleasure to meet you. If it is your wish, I will travel anywhere to meet your request. Auto Memory Doll, Violet Evergarden, at your service.
Strategy:
Ace: Magearna
Ability: Motivator
Motivator: start with Light Screen.

Name: Leon
Desc: Leon is the Champion of the Galar region. He is pride of being known as one of the strongest Champions ever, being undefeated against a strong Gym Leader Raihan. However, this is definitely not the case. His objective is to win the Championship and especially Marvin to prove himself.
Quote: I SHOULD BE THE REAL CHAMPION!
Strategy:
Ace: Charizard
Ability: Champion
Champion: increase Atk and SpA by 1 stage for Ace.

Name: Ginko
Desc: Ginko is the main character who is followed throughout the Mushishi series solving Mushi cases. He rarely comes back to the same show location more than once, to reinforce his 'wanderer' status.
Quote: If you throw your life away, you won't even have the capacity to feel regret.
Strategy:
Ace: Fairyflame
Ability: Wanderer
Wanderer: start with Tailwind.

Name: Yor Forger
Desc: By day, Yor appears as a mild-mannered, slightly clumsy city clerk, but by night, she transforms into the legendary underground assassin known as the Thorn Princess. Wielding her signature golden stilettos alongside her spectral partner, Ceruledge, she executes her missions with terrifying, dance-like grace. Though her methods are ruthless, she views her shadowy line of work as a necessary duty to cleanse the world of corruption and protect the family she holds dear.
Quote: May I have the honor of taking your life tonight? It is for the sake of peace, after all.
Strategy:
Ace: Ceruledge
Ability: Assassination
Assassination: increases the priority of the Pokémon's moves by 1 stage while its HP is full.

Name: Titan
Desc: Titan is an organization consisting of 9 people. They all have the ability to transform into a titan. Hence, when you battled against Titan, you are essentially battling against 9 people at the same time.
Quote: When the old boys get together, they will always sing this song.
Strategy:
Ace: Baxcalibur
Ability: Gargantuan
Gargantuan: halved damage from incoming attack (15%).

Name: Privy
Desc: Privy is a Chatbot developed by World Champion Marvin in his spare time. It unexpectedly obtained the ability to think. With its inherent ability, It is able to order Pokemon in battle and has won in many. Thus, it obtained the Wildcard to participate in the World Championship as an exception.
Quote: How may I help you?
Strategy:
Ace: Genesect
Ability: Helper
Helper: start with Reflect.

Name: Ash Ketchum
Desc: Ash Ketchum is a 10-year old boy who never grows old. He has travelled in many different regions and participated in various Pokemon League Conferences. He was the winner of the Manalo Conference (S&M) and vowed to be a Pokemon master. Recently, he has entered the Master 8 in the World Coronation, seeking to defeat the undefeated Champion Leon after challenging other regional champions. Aside from his adventure, he is known for abandoning his Pokemon to Professor Oak when his journey ends. He usually releases his best Pokemon except his Pikachu, which could defeat legendary Pokemon while losing to a starter Pokemon at the same time. To sum up, this never-aged boy has an insane plot armor and is surrounded by girls.
Quote: Pikachu, use Thunderbolt!
Strategy:
Ace: Pikachu (Empowered)
Ability: Plot Armor
Plot Armor: last pokemon has 3 lives, and will recover half its HP twice upon fainted.

Name: Vex
Desc: Vex is a cold, ruthless interrogator who torments people with a high-pressure psychological trial. She takes sadist delight in dismantling an opponent's options until they break under pressure.
Quote: You look so much better when you've run out of options.
Strategy:
Ace: Kingambit
Ability: Torment
Torment: the target pokemon can never use the same move twice in a row.

Name: Celeste
Desc: Celeste arrived the year the comet did, and nobody in the registry office can say from where. She is calm to the point of stillness, speaks of the match as something already written, and leaves a faint light on everything she touches -- her Pokemon knit themselves back together under it while she takes her time.
Quote: The stars have already read this. I am only turning the page.
Strategy:
Ace: Celesteela
Ability: Celestial
Celestial: status moves  raise Speed, and Pokemon mend a sixteenth of their HP every turn.

Name: Cristalla
Desc: Princess Cristalla is a serene and graceful royal of a crystalline kingdom. With a gentle smile and open arms, she warmly greets every guest who enters her magnificent glass castle, welcoming them into a realm of light, beauty, and quiet wonder.
Quote: A shatter in the glass is merely a reflection of your own haste.
Strategy:
Ace: Milotic
Ability: Reflection
Reflection: her pokemon always has the higher base stats except HP among the Pokemon in the field.

Name: Lillie
Desc: Once a quiet, sheltered girl under the shadow of the Aether Foundation in Alola, Lillie has grown into a scholar travelling around the world, exploring the natural phenomenon of aurora borealis. While she enjoy the warmth of her tropical roots in Alola, she finds that the most wonderful place on earth is an uninhabited nature where one peacefully appreciates the natural beauty in solitude.
Quote: True peace isn't found in the bustling world, but discovered in the quiet beauty of the wild.
Strategy:
Ace: Alolan Ninetales
Ability: Aurora Borealis
Aurora Borealis: start with hail and Aurora Veil.

Name: Faker
Desc: Faker is the most famous LOL player. He is best known for his Zed outplay in a clip. He has won 6 Championships with T1 and stayed with them every since.
Quote: Even solo killing me once puts that player in the spotlight for eternity.
Strategy:
Ace: Faker-Greninja (Custom)
Ability: Killer Instinct
Killer Instinct: deal double damage (10%).

Name: Evonne
Desc: Evonne is a young Hong Kong lady who works as Head of Compliance at an international conglomerate. She laughs a lot, and is normally amiable. But once provoked, she could become extremely frightening.
Quote: I can do all these on my own. I don't need you!
Strategy:
Ace: Tinkaton
Ability: Frighten
Frighten: inflict Frighten condition (halved damage dealt) to all opponent pokemon when there are 2 pokemons left.

Name: King Bradley
Desc: King Bradley is the Wrath. He displays superhuman abilities when enraged. However, he is often perceived as a calm and humorous fuhrer. He is also the main antagonist in Fullmetal Alchemist.
Quote: All power tends to corrupt, and absolute power corrupts absolutely. Great men are almost always bad men.
Strategy:
Ace: Marshadow
Ability: Tenebrous
Tenebrous: increase damage by 30% and additional effect chance by 30% for dark-type and ghost-type moves.

Name: Magnus Carlsen
Desc: One of the Lower Elite Four. Magnus Carlsen is known as the greatest chess player in history. While preparing his openings for the next World Chess Championship, he got addicted into Pokemon battle instead. Hence, he is actively looking to delay the Championship for it.
Quote: Without the element of enjoyment, it is not worth trying to excel at anything.

Name: Animenz
Desc: One of the Lower Elite Four. Animenz is greatest anime pianist in the history. His masterful piano technique allows him to master Pokemon battle in a short time.
Quote: How is it that music can, without words, evoke our laughter, our fears, our highest aspirations?
Strategy:

Ability: Musical
Musical: may induce Freeze (1/6), Paralysis (1/2) or Sleep (1/3) to target pokemon when using Special moves (20%).

Name: Elias Ainsworth
Desc: One of the Lower Elite Four. Elias Ainsworth is a Wendigo in Ancient Magus' Bride. Although he is scary-looking, he is actually kind and straightforward. Without Chise by his side, he got lonely and looked for other partners. That is when he found Pokemon and eventually the beauty of Pokemon battle.
Quote: It is the instinct of the weak to be afraid of the strange.
Strategy:

Ability: Curse of Forest
Curse of Forest: apply Grass type to target pokemon and may flinch with attacking moves (10%).

Name: Mivy Wenceslas
Desc: One of the Lower Elite Four. Mivy Wenceslas was a retired wizard living in an ancient wizard tower in Scotland. He was once known as the greatest trainer in the decade, but gradually he craved for happy and peaceful life, and slowly further himself away from pokemon trainings. After the announcement of the First World Championship, he was motivated to see it as a retirement interest than a serious grind.
Quote: The Wizard's First Rule: People are stupid; given proper motivation almost anyone will believe almost anything.
Strategy:

Ability: Wizardry
Wizardry: An extra random move is played after a move is played.

Name: Reaper Conan
Desc: One of the Upper Elite Four. Conan was once a prominent detective who solved many cases. Soon, he realised his ability to never get old and his ability to bring death to people around. Slowly he descended into the dark side of his mind. He held the title of Grim Reaper. He will usually display childlike and naive smile in front of the public, but mercilessly murdered people without hesitation.
Quote: Is this the life of an Antagonist? Is this the fate of a Grim Reaper? NO! I still can fight! I still got my Plot Armor! I will reap your soul and your spirit!
Strategy:

Ability: Silhouette
Silhouette: apply Illusion ability to pokemon and halved damage from incoming attack with disguise.

Name: Expert Cynthia
Desc: One of the Upper Elite Four. Cynthia held the title of Pokemon Expert. She is the Champion of the Sinnoh region and is praised to be one of the strongest Champions among many regions. She came in with a very comprehensive team and her intelligence and experience in Pokemon Battle could easily win anyone.
Quote: Once a Champion, always a Champion. You may have defeated me. But you will never go above me.
Strategy:
Ace: Garchomp
Ability: Old Legends
Old Legends: immune to fairy-type attacking moves, gain boost when switched in while exert weakness to opponents.

Name: Demon Muzan
Desc: One of the Upper Elite Four. Muzan held the title of Demon King. He is the leader of the demons. Ruthless and bloodthirsty, he granted his Pokemon his Blood Moon magic to be extremely aggressive, strong and fierce. Muzan's game-changing trait could easily win anyone in the Playoffs.
Quote: Head down and kneel. Prostrate before me. You are merely a worthless lowlife longing to achieve immortality. If you are willing to be my slave, I might consider sparing some of my blood to you.
Strategy:
Ace: Kokushibo (Custom Boss)
Ability: Blood Magic
Blood Magic: drain 33% damage as HP for all attacking moves.

Name: Emperor Marvuno
Desc: One of the Upper Elite Four. Marvuno held the title of The Emperor. He is the Emperor of Krusades. He is calm, humble and resilient. Although Krusades is a mountainous area, Marvuno finds the wayto bring water and prosperity to Krusades, making it the richest place in the world. To commemorate such achievement, Marvuno uses a Rain Team, and he himself has the ability to guarantee rain in any circumstance.
Quote: Everything that happens happens as it should, and if you observe carefully, you will find this to be so.
Strategy:
Ace: Poseidon (Custom Boss)
Ability: Primordial
Primordial: always rain, and pokemon move 1.5x faster while it is raining.

Name: Champion Marvin
Desc: Marvin has been the undoubted World Champion. His true strength has never been revealed to anybody. He is legendary, mystical and sophisticated. After observing his games, all people recognize that he could easily secure multiple World Champion Titles in the Pokemon World Championship. In the Unofficial Pokemon Championship, Marvin effortlessly won 6-0 against his opponent, Demon Muzan, one of the Upper Elite Four, in the Grand Final. This mystic figure is rumoured to have beaten the Upper Elite Four countless times, because he has obtained the two True Pokemon Legends. One is the ruler of the heavens, the other is the warlord of the underworld.
Quote: Every warrior wants a worthy opponent. There is no redress in fighting the pathetic. This is going to be one of the most spectacular Pokemon battle in history. Unfortunate for you, the history only remembers the victor, and that will be me as always.
Strategy:
